meta.title: Investor Information
meta.description: LipoNexus investment opportunity: non-invasive blood test for the $5B+ liver diagnostics market. Contact us for partnership and investment inquiries.

hero.headline: Request Investor Materials
hero.body: Provide your contact information to receive investor materials via email.

points.title: Large & Underserved Market
points.description: Over 1 billion people globally have fatty liver disease, with the vast majority undiagnosed. The global liver disease diagnostics market exceeds $5 billion and is growing rapidly.

points.title: Proprietary Technology
points.description: LipoNexus has identified a novel panel of inflammatory lipid biomarkers with strong intellectual property protection and a clear path to clinical validation.

points.title: First-Mover Advantage
points.description: No blood-based test currently exists for accurate, non-invasive fatty liver disease staging. We are positioned to establish the category standard.

points.title: Proven Team
points.description: Our leadership and advisors bring extensive experience across lipid biochemistry, clinical hepatology, diagnostics development, and regulatory affairs.

points.title: Multiple Revenue Streams
points.description: Direct-to-lab licensing, pharma clinical trial partnerships, and consumer-facing wellness applications create diverse monetization pathways.

points.title: Clear Regulatory Path
points.description: Our IVD strategy targets FDA 510(k) clearance with a companion diagnostic pathway for NASH drug development programs.

contact.headline: Connect With Us
contact.body: We welcome conversations with healthcare-focused investors, strategic corporate partners, and research collaborators. Please reach out to discuss our current funding round and partnership opportunities.
